notes.title: Japanese School Life Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed bugs where certain Steam achievements weren't unlocking. 
To retrieve your old saves: right click Japanese School Life in you Steam game library, go to Properties->Local Files->Browse Local Files, and copy the contents of the savedata subdirectory to %APPDATA%\Roaming\CODEJP\SEKAIPROJECT\JAPANESE SCHOOL LIFE
